name: Myxoid/Round Cell Liposarcoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Soft Tissue Tumors

criteria.description: Presence of myxoid stroma with lipoblasts and round cell components on histological examination
Detection of FUS-DDIT3 or EWSR1-DDIT3 gene fusion by molecular testing
MRI showing well-defined soft tissue mass with myxoid matrix and characteristic vascular pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of myxoid and round cell components plus detection of characteristic gene fusion
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Round cell component >5% is associated with higher grade and worse prognosis

laboratory: No specific blood test abnormalities; possible anemia in advanced disease
imaging: MRI showing lobulated mass with myxoid matrix and prominent vascular pattern
CT scan to assess for metastases
other: Histopathology demonstrating myxoid stroma with lipoblasts and round cell areas
Immunohistochemistry positive for S-100 protein in lipoblasts

distinguishingFeatures: Different clinical behavior and genetic profile

redFlags: Onset of pain or neurological deficits
references: WHO Classification of Tumours of Soft Tissue and Bone, 5th Edition, 2020
Fletcher CDM et al. Diagnostic Histopathology of Tumors, 4th Edition, 2013
